question: Which among the following is the largest country in the Europe according to land area (in sq km)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Russia** is the largest country in Europe by land area.
 
• It spans approximately **3,969,100 square kilometers** in Europe, although its total area extends into Asia as well.
 
• Russia's vast land area in Europe makes it significantly larger than other European countries.
